candidateEvaluations.strategy: Instant One-Tap Redemption Focus: Surface points balance, high-urgency expiration banner (calm tone, no countdown/artificial scarcity), and a prominent instant reward grid for 1-click quick redemption.
Re-engagement Flash Deal Grid: Highlight a playful quick-win challenge paired with instant reward options to restart activity without notification pressure.

approvedCustomerStory.oneSentenceStory: Easily redeem your expiring points for instant vouchers before they disappear.
approvedCustomerStory.customerSituation: Customer has 1,500 points expiring in 7 days after a period of inactivity.
approvedCustomerStory.storyTension: Risk of losing accumulated point value due to impending expiration without high friction.
approvedCustomerStory.customerResolution: Select and claim a low-friction instant reward in one tap.
approvedCustomerStory.primaryOutcome: Instant realization of reward value for expiring points with minimum friction.
